scope: NekoClaw host/main-server restart while a multi-step task-agent commission is queued, working, or waiting for the user.

native_gap.ledger_reconcile: nekoclaw/host/ledger.py::_reconcile transitions prior-host queued, working and waiting_user commissions to failed with HOST_ENDED_REASON, except deferred and resting work.
native_gap.native_test: tests/unit/nekoclaw/test_host_ledger.py::test_unfinished_commissions_of_an_earlier_process_fail_on_open explicitly freezes queued/working/waiting_user -> failed across a new Ledger instance.
native_gap.passive_failure_delivery: tests/unit/nekoclaw/test_host_ledger.py::test_what_an_earlier_process_left_unfinished_is_reported_with_its_failure proves a passive task_result is enqueued instead of continuation.
native_gap.session_durability: Task-agent session_dir/session_id/runtime/transcript are durable. Native tests prove blocked/waiting sessions can reopen at the transcript tail and runtime-process loss can be recovered without discarding session state.
native_gap.runtime_process_recovery: tests/unit/nekoclaw/test_host_task_agents.py covers runtime process exit and subsequent resumed=true continuation inside a surviving host.
native_gap.host_restart_difference: The missing seam is therefore host-level continuation policy/reconciliation, not transcript persistence, runtime session reopen, task ledger, or journal durability.

effect_safety.risk: Automatically requeueing every interrupted working commission is unsafe because the previous process may have died after an external effect but before its result/audit terminal write.
effect_safety.existing_evidence: Ledger reconciliation changes running host_calls to interrupted and call_audit.reclaim preserves existing host-call authority; interrupted must not be treated as proof that no effect occurred.
effect_safety.safe_direction: Any future continuation must distinguish an effect-free checkpoint from an interrupted/uncertain external call and must reuse existing ledger/session/call-audit state rather than replaying blindly.

reuse_order.candidate: N.E.K.O current pin Ledger + TaskAgentManager + runtime transcript/session recovery
reuse_order.reason: All durable authority and resume primitives already exist; the observable gap is the host-restart policy that fails active commissions.
Git compare is identical at review time; there is no newer upstream host-restart continuation seam to absorb.
Existing commission/session rows, call audit, transcript, runtime reopen and durable outbox are the required authority boundaries.
No pinned surface/provider owns NekoClaw commission lifecycle across host restart.
Introducing one would create a second task ledger/orchestrator and violate the frozen N.E.K.O authority; their recovery ideas may inform tests only.
First reproduce the exact native host-restart gap and classify in-flight call safety. A later candidate may only reuse existing Ledger/TaskAgentManager/call-audit primitives.

allowed: machine-verifiable source/test probe proving current host-restart behavior
selection of existing native recovery tests in the agent push gate
forbidden: automatic requeue implementation before effect-boundary classification
fresh execution after an interrupted host call

machine_acceptance: Pinned N.E.K.O still fails prior-host queued/working/waiting_user commissions on ledger reopen.
Pinned N.E.K.O still preserves blocked, deferred and resting states rather than flattening every state.
Native TaskAgentManager still supports transcript-tail resume for blocked/waiting work and runtime-process loss.
Running host calls are still marked interrupted during reconcile.
No native host-restart auto-resume seam has appeared; if it appears, the probe must fail and force reuse re-evaluation.
promotion_policy: PROBE_ONLY_NO_RUNTIME_PROMOTION until a separate reuse decision proves a safe effect-aware continuation policy and machine acceptance for crash-before-effect versus crash-after-effect.
retirement_condition: Retire this probe when pinned N.E.K.O natively provides host-restart continuation/reconciliation for active commissions with explicit treatment of interrupted/uncertain external effects, or when upstream changes the relevant ledger/session/call-audit semantics and this review is re-run.
conclusion: PROBE_NATIVE_GAP_ONLY. Reuse durable N.E.K.O state; do not add a second recovery system.
